inner_epicycle.label: unmodeled main-belt mass (epicycle fit)
inner_epicycle.rejection_reason: Per-tracer coherence FAIL: improved Ceres 5.35x and Vesta 6.41x but worsened Earth (0.98x) and Mars (0.84x). A real body must perturb all tracers coherently. Mass (0.69 M_earth at 3.2 AU) observationally ruled out. Attributed to unmodeled Pallas/Hygiea/diffuse belt mass.
inner_epicycle.followup_2026_10_13: Re-run with Mercury 2-day ephemeris (moon_fix re-run): candidate NOT reproduced. Grid best 1.00x null; all 15 refined dBIC negative (-18.5 to -21); null posterior 62.8%. The v1 4.03x/dBIC+901 fit was artifact-assisted: the fitter was grabbing the Mercury-spline artifact plus unmodeled belt mass jointly against the noisier v1 null. With the artifact gone, the belt-mass signal alone cannot beat the null in this grid. Clean null stands. See moon_fix_note.md.

tno_indirect_artifact.label: indirect-term artifact chasing Mercury 30-day spline bias (RESOLVED)
tno_indirect_artifact.rejection_reason: Candidate at 226 deg so its indirect acceleration (-mu_c r_c/|r_c|^3) points (0.695,0.719,0), mostly +y. It fits the common-mode +y systematic via the uniform indirect term, not via planetary direct gravity. 12 M_earth at 11.1 AU (between Saturn and Uranus) would be easily visible. Rejected before tracker scoring by indirect-term coherence test.
tno_indirect_artifact.root_cause: Mercury sampled every 30 d for an 88-d, e=0.206 orbit: cubic spline cut corners (-7.5% mean radius bias -> +22% 1/r^3 pull), injecting a fake constant 1.07e-5 AU/yr^2 indirect acceleration along Mercury's perihelion direction. Proven by independent SPICE+DE440 check (96% magnitude, cos(dir)=+1.0000 with Mercury perihelion). The 12 M_earth/11 AU candidate was the fitter fitting this artifact via the uniform indirect term.
tno_indirect_artifact.resolution: Mercury re-pulled from Horizons at 2-day cadence (mercury_fine.csv, 2740 rows); tno_hunt.py/residual_hunt.py loaders now prefer mercury_fine.csv. Verified: indirect-term bias drops to 2.4e-8 AU/yr^2 (440x). V2 hunt re-run 2026-10-13; see tno_hunt_v2_note.md.

plus_y_systematic.label: unexplained common-mode systematic (NOT a body)
plus_y_systematic.rejection_reason: Would require ~0.11 M_sun at 1000 AU (a visible star) if planetary. Ruled out as planetary. Cause under investigation (see plus_y_systematic_note.md). Must be resolved before TNOs can constrain Planet Nine.

pattern.form: suspected 30-day sampling aliasing of the 27.3-day lunar orbit in EMB construction

moon_sampling_check.label: NOT a bug: investigated, measured effect exactly 0.0 AU
moon_sampling_check.finding: The Moon's position/velocity are used ONLY to build the Earth-Moon barycenter on the planet epoch grid, from exact Horizons samples at those epochs. The lunar orbit itself is never splined; only the (smooth, Sun+planet-driven) EMB trajectory is interpolated. Unlike Mercury -- whose 30-day positions WERE splined for the indirect term -- no aliasing is possible here. Re-pulled Moon at 2-day cadence and interpolated onto the planet grid: EMB position and velocity bit-identical (max |d| = 0.0 AU, 0.0 AU/yr). Exact-zero explained: 30 = 15 x 2, so the 2-day grid contains the 30-day nodes (4-decimal rounding), and np.interp returns exact samples at coincident nodes.
moon_sampling_check.resolution: Loaders in real_data/residual_hunt.py and real_data/tno_hunt.py now prefer moon_fine.csv, interpolated onto the planet epoch grid (same pattern as the Mercury fix). Originals untouched. No-op safeguard: keeps the loader robust if the Moon is ever used at sub-orbital cadence.

stacked_84d_wiggle.label: 84-day stacked-residual oscillation from 4-decimal time rounding (RESOLVED)
stacked_84d_wiggle.root_cause: CSV time_years rounded to 4 decimals. Null trajectory (true time base) sampled at rounded times via np.interp -> per-epoch position error -v*dt (dt up to +/-26 min). Rounding error dt_k oscillates with period exactly 84.4 d (beat between 30-day steps and 4th-decimal truncation: 0.0001/0.0000355 ~ 2.82 steps). Stacked: -dt_k * mean_TNO_velocity. Predicted vs observed stacked: x corr +0.964, z +0.960 (predicted RMS 453 km vs observed 556 km).
stacked_84d_wiggle.rejection_reason: Not a physical signal: period matches the rounding-beat arithmetic exactly; explained quantitatively by the -v*dt model; vanishes (390->5 km, 78x) when exact times are used.
stacked_84d_wiggle.resolution: All CSV time columns rewritten with exact step grids (t=k*30/365.25 or k*2/365.25; backups *.bak); pull scripts fixed (round->repr). tno_hunt.py re-run (v3): 84-day gone, null holdout RMS 3282->414 km (8x). See stacked_wiggle_note.md.

inner_time_rounding_confirmation.label: Time-rounding -v·dt artifact confirmed in inner hunt (RESOLVED)
inner_time_rounding_confirmation.root_cause: Same round(t,4) time-labeling bug as stacked_84d_wiggle, ~10x larger for inner tracers (faster). Predicted -v·dt RMS matches observed null improvement to 0.6%. v1 0.69-Mearth@3.2AU candidate fully accounted for (Mercury-spline artifact + time-rounding noise); stays dead in v3 (grid best 1.01x, all dBIC<0).

inner_planet_spline_dc_bias.label: Inner-planet 30-day spline DC bias + P_fine linear-interp bias (RESOLVED)

phantom_fitted.post_cubic_fix: 7.14e-09 M_sun @ 31.2 AU, dBIC +7758 (unmodeled belt mass, not a planet)

inner_planet_spline_dc_bias.source: TNO null (74 TNOs); isolation via null_only.py (fine/coarse/spice rail modes)
inner_planet_spline_dc_bias.root_cause: Two layers: (1) 30-day cubic-spline rails for Venus/Earth inadequate (7.5 samples/Venus orbit) — same artifact class as Mercury 30-day problem; fixed by 2-day re-pull (1193->500 km). (2) DOMINANT: P_fine + linear interpolation in accel() introduced ~4.4 km/yr^2 DC bias in y; direct cubic-spline evaluation eliminates it (500->13 km). The gm_fix_note.md 30-day DC diagnosis conflated the two layers. Fix: 2-day rails + direct spline eval in tno_hunt.py, residual_hunt.py, tno_hunt_40yr.py.
inner_planet_spline_dc_bias.lesson: Never linearly interpolate precomputed planet positions in the force loop; evaluate the cubic splines directly. Rail sampling (2-day) and evaluation (cubic) are separate concerns — test them separately.
